release-coordinator: Morning wave heads-up — planning to push morning wave 4 tomorrow 09:30 PT. Need owners for: canary deploy, smoke checks, rollback readiness, DB migration watcher. Who's on deck? I'll coordinate handoff. @alex @maria @sanjay

alex: I can take canary deploy + watch perf during canary. Will be online at 09:15.

maria: I'll own smoke checks + quick e2e. Can run smoke checklist below and post results here. Will be on call 09:20-10:00. :rocket:

```
SMOKE CHECKLIST
- sanity endpoints (login, search, generate)
- ingestion path (write -> read)
- embeddings smoke sample 5 queries
- latency p50/p95 baseline compare
- tail error sampling
```

sanjay: I'm standby for rollback + DB migration watcher. If migration lands I'll run `pg:rollback` plan. Ping me in thread when migrate starts.

kim: small change to runtime config landed — it's in canary group A. tagging @devex for any doc notes.

devops-bot: scheduled window created: /deploy window morning-4 2026-03-18T09:30-10:30PT. Auto-run smoke webhook set to /smoke-runner.

alex: quick Q — what's the abort criteria? CPU > 85% for 5min or error rate > 1%? :eyes: 

release-coordinator: Yes: abort if 5min p95 latency regresses >200ms OR errors >1% sustained 5m OR CPU >85% sustained 5m. If abort, rollback to v2026.03.14-canary. Also: no DB migrations without explicit +1 from @sanjay.

maria: acknowledged. I'll post smoke results in this thread with timestamps + logs (attach short summary + link to detailed logs). :+1:

jenkins-bot: preflight checks passed: infra health OK, loadgen green. See https://ci.internal/reports/234 for details.

sanjay: I'll prep rollback playbook and the 'fast rollback' runbook. Leaving checklist here: - halt router - switch traffic to fallback pool - confirm cache flush - run schema revert if needed - validate traces & downstreams.

release-coordinator: thanks all. I'll send final reminder 08:30 PT and add canary assignment (A: alex, B: kim). Drop any last-minute requests here by EOD.
